acceptance: Reproduce: edit a tracked file while hooks run for a commit of other files, and observe whether the edit survives.
If the hook framework's unstaged-change stash causes it, make the hook run refuse or warn rather than drop the edit, or document the rule in docs/agent with the exact failure mode.
A test or scripted reproduction is kept if practical.
context: Unconfirmed report from a delegated worker; reproduce before changing anything.
description: While landing the primary-clone guard (PR #3888), a docs edit made in the worktree while a commit's hooks were running disappeared without error. The pre-commit stash of unstaged changes is the suspect but was not confirmed. Silent loss of work is worse than a failed commit.
